readme:
# Gemini Omni Flash 1.2 Text to Video

Gemini Omni Flash 1.2 generates a 3–15 second clip with synchronized audio from a written prompt. Compared with 1.1, it supports longer clips, follows references more closely, and costs less per second.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 20,000 characters. |
| `resolution` | `360p` / `720p` / `1080p` / `4k` | `720p` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `duration` | integer 3–15 | 8 | Output length in seconds. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `16:9` / `9:16` | `16:9` | Output frame shape. |

## Billing

You pay for output seconds: $0.023 at 360p, $0.07 at 720p, $0.105 at 1080p, and $0.21 at 4K.

| Output | 360p | 720p | 1080p | 4k |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3s | $0.07 | $0.21 | $0.32 | $0.63 |
| 8s (default) | $0.18 | $0.56 | $0.84 | $1.68 |
| 10s | $0.23 | $0.70 | $1.05 | $2.10 |
| 15s | $0.34 | $1.05 | $1.57 | $3.15 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe subject, action, camera, and sound in plain sentences.
- Quote dialogue and name the speaker.

## Limits

- 16:9 or 9:16 only.

## Also on SandBase

Other Gemini Omni Flash 1.2 endpoints: `google/gemini-omni-flash/1.2/image-to-video`, `google/gemini-omni-flash/1.2/reference-to-video`, `google/gemini-omni-flash/1.2/edit`, `google/gemini-omni-flash/1.1/text-to-video` (previous version).
